profileText: A Delegate from Maryland; born in Bohemia Manor, Cecil County, Md., October 6, 1734; attended Princeton College, Princeton, NJ.; member of the Maryland convention of December 29, 1775; served in the Revolutionary War, appointed by the provincial convention colonel of the Lower Battalion of Harford County, Md., in 1776; member of the council of safety, 1776; Delegate to the Second Continental Congress, 1776-1777; chief justice of the Maryland Court of Appeals, 1778-1805; died on March 7, 1808, in Joppa, Harford County, Md.; interment in the Old St. John's Cemetery, Joppatowne, Md.
